additional_info.subject: Reported issue
additional_info.body: The charging station regularly reports the error "InternalError - error in the internal hardware or software component" to the Chargecloud backend and then charging processes that were actually authorized by the backend are not started and the customers drive away again.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0377527 - ID0377527-DC/Si-D/DE- [Y2 / S5 313657916001] Internal Error CRM:02023000120
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Jens Wilkens,﻿
We have reviewed the logs from the past week and observed that the Internal Error occurred only three times during this period. Upon analyzing the logs associated with these errors, we found that the charging sessions were successful in each instance.
To address the issues you've encountered, we recommend upgrading your charger's firmware to
4.0.11
. Firmware updates typically include bug fixes, performance enhancements, and improved compatibility with electric vehicle communication protocols. Implementing this update should help mitigate the errors you've experienced.
If you would like us to proceed with the firmware upgrade, please let us know your preferred date and time for the update.
I hope this answers your query.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
